reason: Approved within the Brand Designer remit: inspected encoded samples show a coherent black/ivory/gold identity, consistent Arabic hierarchy, recognizable faceless character and preserved product identity. The closing samples give the brand, owner-specified 15.99 SAR and purchase direction a clear visual hierarchy. This is a visual-brand approval; it does not certify narration naturalness or complete music removal.

evidence.finding: At 0.000/1.040/4.290 seconds the ivory faceless character and gold emphasis read consistently against black; at 8.650/12.575 seconds the warm light field retains the same book identity; at 15.700/18.550/22.775 seconds actual program/app imagery shares the palette. At 27.650 and 29.700 seconds the logo, book, price, CTA and store URL remain visually consistent.

Sampled handoffs keep captions in a dedicated lower band. Product expansion near 6.3–7.1 seconds carries the book into the light scene. Transitional title opacity is deliberately low in some samples, with settled headings restored afterward; these are intermediate frames, not evidence of continuous-playback readability.
Documented colors #121210/#f9f5e9/#d1ac65 and Lalezar/Noto Sans Arabic are reflected in source. Source uses book-cover.svg and closing-logo.png directly and separates caption and scene layers.

Brand covers, logo and actual app screenshots have recorded source/hashes; character is described as an original SVG reinterpretation. Claim map locates 4/5-day programs, 500 app recipes and owner price. These are provenance records, not my independent legal ownership certification.

Contrast checker reports 33/33 sampled checks passing. Source browser reports book visible by 7.2 seconds, protected caption bounds and final CTA settled by 26.35 seconds with 3.45-second hold. One duplicate-media lint warning remains; sampled output shows no resulting identity defect.
Records report 1080×1920, 60/1 fps, 1788 frames over 29.8 seconds and a deployed video matching the local SHA256. I did not repeat encoding or network checks.

strengths: Restrained reusable palette and Arabic typography unify the character, product, application and final offer.
Headline/caption separation supports a consistent reading order.
The product cover and logo remain recognizable across contrasting scene backgrounds.
issues: Some fine app copy, disclaimer text and the store URL are substantially smaller than headings; actual phone-size legibility beyond sampled checks was not established here.
limitations: I inspected still contact sheets and source/test records; I did not watch continuous video or personally assess motion smoothness.

No human listening capability was available. audio-edit.json documents source cuts, no pitch change and no music track added, but those facts cannot establish naturalness, intelligibility or complete background-music removal. These remain unresolved outside this brand-specific approval.
Provenance assertions were read; asset ownership/licensing was not independently adjudicated. No audience recognition or conversion study was supplied.
non_applicable_criteria: Medical/nutritional validation, checkout/fulfillment, campaign sales outcomes and formal legal clearance are outside this visual-brand review.
